$comment: Atlas evaluation questions with ground-truth answers. Every answer was checked on 2026-10-01 against the source recorded with it; each question pins its reference (census year, survey edition, named service, named event).
Great-circle distances are computed (haversine, R=6371.0088 km) from the coordinates given in each derivation; everything else is a figure stated by the cited source.

questions.text: 東海道新幹線の東京駅から新大阪駅までのルートを地図に出して。線路の距離は何 km？

source.states: Line length 515.4 km; fares use the parallel Tokaido Main Line operating distance of 552.6 km.

questions.note: 515.4 km is the actual track length (実キロ); 552.6 km is the operating kilometre (営業キロ) used for fares. Either is correct.
